title: Regular vs Diffuse Reflection
guideExplore: Switch between regular and diffuse surfaces — compare how reflected rays behave.
guideRegular: Regular reflection: parallel incident rays stay parallel after bouncing.
guideDiffuse: Diffuse reflection: rays scatter in many directions from a rough surface.
conditionsHint: Smooth surfaces give regular reflection; rough surfaces scatter light diffusely.
learnMore: Regular reflection from smooth surfaces keeps parallel rays parallel. Rough surfaces scatter rays — that is diffuse reflection.
